g.title: cluster_rebuilt

g.title: rows
g.text: node 5, 15 bp, the one node a route visits
follows R from 1+ to 4+ by route 0
follows R from 1+ to 4+ by route 1
follows R from 1+ to 4+, no routes
Every row starts with its sequence and the stretch it is about: a walk row its piece's span, the
tile's ref, nodes and route rows the tile's extent, GRCh38#0#chr1 0 40. The file holds each distinct
route once, and a walk row lists only the routes its path takes.
